calls.title: Ashley <> Larissa - Connet on Demand Generation role
calls.summary: The meeting centered on the talent acquisition strategy to recruit specialized marketing talent with a focus on developer marketing to meet ambitious growth goals. Emphasis was placed on hiring developer marketing experts, particularly for an urgent demand generation role, alongside discussions of specific candidates like Fung Lin and Nick Fitzsimmons. Geographic flexibility allows hiring in the US and Canada, with potential global candidates, although European hiring support is currently limited. The proposed recruitment timeline spans six weeks, with parallel searches for developer advocate roles. Participants underlined the importance of technical skills for candidate credibility, as well as discussed compensation benchmarks to ensure clarity in recruitment efforts.
calls.keywords: Demand Generation, Developer Advocate, Technical Recruiting, Developer Marketing, Remote Hiring, Candidate Pipeline
